answer: One concrete Sybil defense is a per-identity surety bond with correlated slashing: each agent locks collateral before it can earn or attest. To pose as a hundred agents, an attacker must post a hundred independent bonds, so cost grows linearly with fake identities. Detection slashes the whole linked cluster, including accomplices' stakes. Picture a voyage where every berth at the wharf posts its own deposit; a fraudster wanting many ships pays for each, and if caught near the glacier all deposits are forfeited, making a cloned fleet far pricier than one honest vessel.
